announcements.title: Work From Home  - 26 September
announcements.content:
Hi everyone,

Due to the heavy rain forecast for Kanpur tomorrow, we will be working from home tomorrow, 26 September, for everyone’s safety and to avoid unnecessary travel.

Please remain available during regular working hours and continue with your planned tasks and meetings as usual.

Stay safe and take care.

epics.title: Update CCF Milestone Tracker
epics.description: Keep CCF's tracker current; notify CCF of any change or upgrade to milestones; confirm the end date with CCF once milestones are mapped (start date is fixed per contract).

epics.title: Milestones (all) completion
epics.description: Deliver all five contract milestones: data pipelines and integration, CropRisk.ai platform, pilot validation (including securing a partner or pilot agreement with an insurer or lender), reporting/outreach workshops, and ongoing monitoring and compliance.

epics.title: Reporting and closing
epics.description: Updates shared to CCF, including catching up on quarterly and mid-term reports already missed, spend tracking and utilisation certificate prep, impact assessment (social and climate indicators), case study, and final dissemination report.

epics.title: Develop 5 Proposals
epics.description: Complete technically and commercially structured proposals.

initiatives.title: Investor-ready and project-funding-ready business plan
initiatives.description: A verified, data-backed business plan for ClimAgro Analytics — built pillar by pillar (Strategy & Positioning, Product, Sales/GTM, Finance, Governance, Funding) on confirmed facts rather than the unreconciled claims in past proposals — ready to use as-is in investor conversations and in project-specific funding applications (CCF/Cummins, NABARD, and future grants)
